experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Embark on a full-day longtail boat tour around the stunning Phi Phi archipelago, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters at Maya Bay, exploring hidden lagoons, and stopping at Monkey Beach. Book an early morning departure to beat the crowds and midday heat. On rainy days, opt for an indoor Thai cooking class in Krabi town as an alternative.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Market Tour
experiences.description: Explore the legendary street food scene at Yaowarat Road (Chinatown) and the nearby Talat Noi neighborhood. Sample pad kra pao, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, boat noodles, and fresh seafood from local vendors. Evening tours avoid the brutal midday heat and bring the markets to life with vibrant lights and energy. Join a guided walking food tour for insider access to hidden stalls.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Sunrise Kayaking Through Mangroves
experiences.description: Paddle through the serene mangrove forests of Koh Lanta at sunrise when temperatures are cool and wildlife is most active. Spot monitor lizards, exotic birds, and vibrant marine life in the shallow waters. This guided kayaking experience includes a stop at a secluded beach for breakfast. Indoor alternative: visit the Lanta Old Town cultural village and its charming wooden stilt-house museums on rainy afternoons.

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar Street Food Crawl
experiences.description: Wander through the famous Night Bazaar and Anusarn Market in Chiang Mai, tasting northern Thai specialties like khao soi (coconut curry noodle soup), sai oua (herbed sausage), and crispy pork rinds. The cool evening air makes this a perfect activity after a day of sightseeing. On rainy evenings, duck into the covered Anusarn Food Court for the same authentic flavors in a sheltered setting.

experiences.name: Similan Islands Full-Day Snorkeling Expedition
experiences.description: Join a guided boat trip to the world-renowned Similan Islands, one of Thailand's top diving and snorkeling destinations. Explore vibrant coral reefs teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, and tropical fish. Depart early morning from Khao Lak pier to maximize time on the water before afternoon winds pick up. If weather is unfavorable, visit the Khao Lak-Lam Ru National Park visitor center and rainforest trails as an indoor-friendly alternative.
